d: When a spoiled Beverly Hills teenager needs to be taught a lesson she is sent to the local ski-town, by her guardian angel mother to help save her aunt's failing bakery and learn the importance of helping others.

Fourteen-year-old LeAnn Rimes wants nothing more than to sing at the Grand Ole Opry.  She is invited to sing at a Christmas concert on Nashville's famous stage, but upon her arrival, she is faced with a difficult decision.

The Christmas Bunny is the story of a Michigan family, facing tough economic times, who take in a withdrawn foster child, Julia. Convinced she's unlovable, Julia dreams of becoming "real," like the Velveteen Rabbit in her treasured storybook video.
Pee-Wee Herman throws a Christmas party at his playhouse with his friends and some celebrity guests.

Big Earl is the owner of a Christmas tree lot, he has a big heart and big visions. The week before Christmas, his son Derrick, trying to prove to his dad that he is a success, gets into trouble and puts the survival of his dad’s business in jeopardy.
Santa Claus winds up in jail after a 7-year-old sets a trap in order to prove his existence to her family.

In a world where the holidays are run by the efficient Bureau of Yuletide Affairs, a bitter and burned-out Ghost of Christmas Past decides to go AWOL while on a "mission" and leave his "target" stranded in 1965.
A reporter tries to uncover and bring closure to a long-lost, undelivered gift before Christmas.
A life-sized nativity leads a man to learn about his past and lost family.
This Lifetime Original Movie stars David Hasselhoff as a sought after consultant hired by a workaholic mother (Caroline Rhea) in an effort to get her and her family through the holidays.
A Family Christmas turns into chaos when Elizabeth returns home and is must plan the annual charity event, with her free-spirited sister Sam. They must learn to work together or Christmas is ruined.
